en: "What!? What is that giant monster!?{n} It's no dragon, either!?{n} It's big! Way too damn big!"
"No... I've heard of this..."
"The fire dragon Salamander."
"A three-headed dragon-type monster some{n} country's army built centuries ago as{n} a heavy assault weapon to take forts."
"But for an ancient monster like that{n} to have survived all this time,{n} on this island of steel of all places."
"Woooooooooooooow!{n} It's like a whole mountain{n} is moving!"
"A mountain's right. This thing is{n} a rumbling volcano in the flesh."
"I'm scared, my priiince!"
"Don't use the confusion to cling to{n} me. It's hot enough already.{n} You'll only make it hotter!"
"Eeek! My flames of love are{n} gonna burn up my priiince!"
"I'll kill you..."
"C'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon!{n} Salamander or whatever, I don't care!{n} I'll blow it away with my bullets!"
"I'm counting on you, Parsifal."
"Well..."
"That's if bullets work on it..."
"A Salamander..."
"A hundred years ago I fought a Hydra,{n} a monster of the same line,{n} but this is a greater beast still."
"I'm a professor, you know! Yep, yep!{n} Brain work is my real job!"
"So I'm leaving the fight with this{n} monster to you lot!{n} I don't like danger!"
"Total combat power... 3200..."
"Our odds of victory are a mere 0.2%.{n} It is a dangerous opponent.{n} It would be best to avoid battle."
"That's right! The robot's got it right!{n} Run! Running is winning!"
"Extreme, but that too is{n} a calm and logical judgment."
"Of course! I'm a professor, you know?{n} I'm always calm and logical!"
"Ooooooooooooooh!?{n} The fierce ki drifting over the{n} volcano is flowing into that monster."
"Therefore, that Salamander{n} can be no ordinary monster!"
"It survived for centuries in the lava.{n} The very symbol of the volcano:{n} a scorching monster cloaked in flame."
"Oh, God! Why do you give us{n} so great a trial!?"
"Could this be a punishment from God!?{n} Burning sinful humans with flame...{n} Is this eternal divine punishment?"
"I see. Divine punishment."
"But Miss Aerial, please be sure never{n} to forget this one thing..."
"Huh?"
"The gods are not always right. At{n} times they bring disaster on humans{n} to protect their own position."
"Even a god, so long as it has{n} feelings, cannot be a being that is{n} always right. Never forget that much."
"What do we do, Lt. {hero:6}!?{n} The volcano's heat will finish us{n} before we beat the Salamander, sir!"
"On the pride of our Romulus,{n} one or two Salamanders are..."
"No! We had better fall back!{n} On the pride of our Romulus: advance{n} to the rear, and nothing else!"
"What are you saying, Cerbera!?{n} You'd have us retreat after{n} coming this far?"
"No! We advance to the rear!{n} It is not a retreat! It is strictly{n} a tactical withdrawal!"
"Turning your back on the enemy{n} is exactly what running away means!"
"Then we retreat walking backwards!"
"What now? Fight, or fall back?"
"This is...?"
"The ring of the Zodiac Twelve Gods{n} is ringing? No... is it calling out{n} to something that calls back?"
"Resonance... is that it...?"
"Could it be there's another ring{n} somewhere in this place!?"
"If so..."
"Then I've got no choice but to take{n} down that Salamander in my way!"
"Listen, watch out for its flames!{n} Take one head-on and you'll be{n} burnt black in no time!"
"C'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon!"
"How's that!? My bullets are custom{n} jobs! Loaded with my bloodlust!{n} Hurry up and break, you monster!"
"Jeez, you're so rough, Parsifal."
"Shut up! Any more lip and I'll{n} fill you full of holes too!"
"No way, I don't wanna!"
"Then cover me or something! You're{n} just an Esper Doll. Don't you go{n} complaining to your human betters!"
"Hmph, so there!"
"All right! That Salamander bastard's{n} sinking down into the volcano!"
"Well done, Lt. {hero:6}!"
"That was a close call, though, sir."
"Oh, God, thank you! For taking{n} the side of us sinners{n} at the very last moment!"
"Whew. The flow of ki is back to{n} normal. It seems that Salamander{n} was the cause of the disturbance."
"The Salamander, too, is a pitiful{n} creature. Made to fight, it is fated{n} to die on a battlefield someday."
"But fate is, by rights, something{n} one carves out with one's own hands..."
"The Salamander has no means to do so.{n} No, it was never allowed any. A pitiful{n} creature that can only fight."
"Declaring end of combat.{n} Victory is ours."
"That's my Prince {hero:6} for you!{n} That's right, slaying dragons is{n} what a prince does for a living!"
"Heh heh! Serves you right!{n} Salamander or whatever, you picked{n} the wrong guy to start a fight with!"
"You do realize I'm a professor?{n} I never, ever want to join{n} a battle this harsh again!"
"A statue appeared from under the lava?"
"The ring's making a sound?"
"Is this statue resonating with the{n} ring I got at Special Service HQ,{n} the 'Twelve Keys' ring or whatever?"
"You who stand before my statue:{n} are you one who will dispel{n} the darkness of the world?"
"Hey, hey, what's going on here?{n} The statue's yapping away!"
"My name is Sun God Apollo, one of{n} the Zodiac Twelve Gods who watch and{n} govern this world by the stars' course."
"A blink of an eye to us, a long age{n} to you: a hundred years have we{n} marked upon this island."
"And now, upon this island, the seal{n} on us Twelve Gods has been broken."
"Hmph, a well-made machine. It reacts{n} to whoever holds a ring and talks{n} automatically. That's the trick."
"Still, these so-called Ancient Gods{n} sure made nothing but weird stuff."
"Seek out the statues...{n} In lands you have visited once...{n} and in lands you have yet to visit..."
"Find every statue of the Twelve Gods{n} and turn their power into rings."
"When you have gathered all twelve{n} rings, we shall acknowledge you{n} as the agent of the gods."
"Set it right."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"The seal has been broken."
"The seal on us Zodiac Twelve Gods{n} has been broken after a hundred years."
"Agent of the gods, huh?{n} Set the course of this world right, huh?"
"Man, what a roundabout way to talk.{n} Basically, I just have to collect{n} twelve rings lying around somewhere."
"And if I do, I get my hands on{n} some incredible power, right?"
"The rings you now hold..."
"The rings that yet remain..."
"Set it right."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"My name is Sun God Apollo."
"Now is the time to fulfill{n} the ancient covenant."
"My name is Sun God Apollo."
"Now that's a well-made gimmick.{n} In the blink of an eye, the statue{n} turned into this tiny little ring."
"These Ancient Gods who made it{n} must've really loved theatrics."
"Then again, it's sure to be a hit{n} with military men who love theatrics.{n} So bad they can taste it..."
"Well, whatever."
"This ring's supposed to be a key,{n} right? So if I collect twelve, I get{n} to lay eyes on the Almighty Treasure?"
"Looks like this trip just got{n} a bit more interesting."
"It's resonating with the ring I have."
"My name is Sun God Apollo, one of{n} the Zodiac Twelve Gods who watch and{n} govern this world by the stars' course."
"The rings you now hold..."
"The rings that yet remain..."
"Set it right."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"So that's one step closer to the{n} so-called Almighty Treasure{n} sleeping on this island."
"Even a Salamander is only a living{n} creature in the end. It is by no{n} means a foe that cannot be beaten."
"Master Faust, it seems we will manage."
"That, too, is thanks to your{n} strength, Master Ozunu."
"No, I have had a good look at your{n} magic too, Master Faust. A power every{n} bit the equal of my feng shui arts."
"Then let us settle this soon."
"Yes. Binding together the powers{n} of East and West."
"I'm a professor, you know!"
"I'm really smart, so I can tell!{n} That monster's about to go down!{n} Finish it off in one go, like this!"
"Keep it up, Lt. {hero:6}!{n} We've almost got it beaten, sir!"
"Odds of victory up from 27% to 54%.{n} Enemy life factor falling sharply.{n} Continuing combat. Victory is at hand."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
